title: Profile — CV + identity card
description: One owner's identity in two renderings, behind one slug. resume: a formal one-column printable CV (summary / skills / experience / projects) with Print/PDF, rendered by <Resume /> off a configureResume() seam. card: a compact "About This Mac"-style identity card (avatar / monogram, name, roles, outbound links, FAQ accordion) rendered by <AboutProfile /> off a configureAbout() seam. Both render a populated placeholder unwired — zero backend. Install one surface with `npx rr add profile resume|card`, or both with `npx rr add profile`.

items.title: Card
items.description: Compact avatar + links + FAQ identity card (AboutProfile + configureAbout).
